captions.detailed: A flat, circular ring-like disc resembling a custom sword hilt (tsuba). It features a wide, flat top surface, a circular central bore, and a smooth, bullnose rounded outer edge. The overall profile is thin and compact, optimized for 3D printing as a sword guard accessory.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric sword hilt (tsuba) in OpenSCAD with adjustable outer diameter, inner diameter, and thickness. The outer edge of the hilt must be rounded using a rotate_extrude circle, and the center should feature a hollow circular cutout.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a union of two main parts: a flat ring and a rounded outer rim. The flat ring is created using a difference() operation between a main cylinder of radius (outer_diameter/2 - thickness/2) and a central cutout cylinder of radius (inner_diameter/2). The rounded outer rim is generated by translating a circle of radius (thickness/2) along the X-axis by (outer_diameter/2 - thickness/2) and applying a rotate_extrude() operation.
